title_sq: Tek Emerald Center, Shitet Dyqan I Sapo Investuar!!!
description_sq: Tek Emerald Center, Shitet Dyqan I Sapo Investuar!!! Dyqani ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje qendre tregtare 11 kateshe, ndërtim i vitit 2022. Siperfaqja bruto e dyqanit eshte 88m2 dhe neto 80m2. Dyqani eshte i mobiluar dhe ka orientim Jug-Lindje. Dyqani ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar e cila ofron te gjitha facilitetet e mundshme per nje biznes sa me te suksesshem. Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: At Emerald Center, Newly Invested Store For Sale!!!
description_en: At Emerald Center, Newly Invested Store For Sale!!! The store is located on the 0th floor of an 11-story shopping center, built in 2022. The gross area of ​​the store is 88m2 and net 80m2. The store is furnished and has a South-East orientation. The store is located in a developed area that offers all possible facilities for a successful business. It has full mortgage documentation.
